title: Underestimated Privacy Risks for Minority Populations in Large Language Model Unlearning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparate privacy leakage during LLM machine unlearning by comparing Membership Inference Attack (MIA) success rates on randomly selected data versus artificially injected canaries containing rare, underrepresented Personally Identifiable Information (PII), such as infrequent phone area codes, email domains, or years.
